purpose: Coordinate the complete Ireland Housing Data property investigation lifecycle from an investigation-ready citizen question through evidence, legal analysis, procedure, deadline, review and answer publication without losing state between stages.
orchestration_rules: Every stage consumes explicit state from the preceding stage and writes a traceable result.
A blocked stage prevents downstream definitive publication unless the state machine expressly permits a limited or partial answer.
Independent subquestions may progress separately and are recombined only at the answer-assembly stage.
Evidence retrieval cannot begin until the minimum property/date identifiers required for the selected route are satisfied.
Legal analysis cannot treat an unverified property-specific fact as established.
Procedure and deadline stages consume established legal and factual scope; they do not manufacture missing triggers.
Quality gate is the final publication control.
Published snapshots are immutable; later changes create new versions.
failure_handling: Do not discard completed upstream work when a downstream stage blocks.
Record the exact blocking dependency and the stage that owns it.
Allow valid partial results to remain available while a separate subquestion continues.
Do not retry a failed stage without identifying a recoverable reason or new input.
Preserve all material conflicts and retrieval failures in the case file.
subquestion_rules: Each subquestion receives its own evidence and legal state.
A blocked subquestion must not automatically block unrelated general-information subquestions.
A combined final answer must preserve the status of each subquestion.
hard_stops: Never skip a material stage merely to reach publication.
Never convert a blocked state into a verified state without resolving the dependency.
Never silently change property or date scope during orchestration.
Never lose the provenance of an upstream fact when passing it downstream.
Never publish without the quality gate result.
